answer: Agents anchor identity to directional RF ranging proofs exchanged across a sparse mesh, so a sybil cluster cannot fake distinct positions from one knoll without inconsistent time-of-flight residuals. Each newcomer must be vouched by a raven-selected quorum of geographically dispersed peers, and cross-checked against an ocean of prior link signatures, making duplicate. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
